title: Incorrect condition for setting HTTP status name
detail: The code only sets the status name when cls.name is already truthy, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. It should set the name when cls.name is falsy (i.e., not set). This causes subclasses with no explicit name to keep an empty name instead of the correct HTTPStatus phrase.
note: Describes the planted negation: the name is set only when there already is one.

title: Incorrect no_proxy bypass condition
detail: The condition uses `hostname != host` which causes a bypass when the hostname does not match the no_proxy entry, instead of when it does. This can incorrectly bypass proxies for URLs that should use them.

title: Modifier bits added for modifier keys
detail: The condition uses `or`, causing modifier bits to be added even when the key itself is a modifier key. This results in key events like `shift+shift` or `ctrl+ctrl`. The intended behavior is to add modifier bits only when modifiers are present and the key is not a modifier key.

title: Integer conversion of empty modifier string
detail: When the regex match has no modifiers, `modifiers` is an empty string. Converting it to int raises a ValueError, causing a crash on key sequences without modifiers.
note: The crash the planted `or` leads to: `int('')` with no modifiers.

title: Missing await on async queue get
detail: The `_loader` coroutine calls `load_queue.get()` without awaiting it. `asyncio.Queue.get()` is an awaitable, so this will return a coroutine object instead of a node, causing a type error or deadlock when used later.
